characters.name: Hokage
characters.tagline: Kage hat, white flame haori over the jonin flak vest

characters.name: Leaf Jonin
characters.tagline: The standard jonin kit: green flak vest, forehead protector, navy shinobi trousers

characters.name: Uchiha
characters.tagline: Sharingan, blue-black spikes, the clan crest on a high-collared shirt

characters.name: Leaf Genin
characters.tagline: Orange track suit, whisker marks and a brand-new forehead protector

characters.name: Kunoichi
characters.tagline: Red qipao with side slits, long blossom-pink hair, the protector worn as a hairband

characters.name: ANBU Fox
characters.tagline: Fox mask, plated chest armor, white arm guards, a tanto across the back

characters.name: Hyuga
characters.tagline: Wrapped off-white robe and dark sash, a low ponytail and the pale Byakugan

characters.name: Green Beast
characters.tagline: Green bodysuit, orange leg warmers, the protector as a belt, a glossy bowl cut and bold brows

characters.name: ANBU Cat
characters.tagline: Hood up, cat mask with violet stripes, a long grey cloak over the plated armor

characters.name: ANBU Wolf Captain
characters.tagline: Wolf mask, black lacquer pauldrons, the captain's blue scarf and a ninjato across the back

characters.name: ANBU Hawk Tracker
characters.tagline: Beaked hawk mask, black long sleeves under the plates, a bandolier of kunai, strapped shin guards

characters.name: Root Agent
characters.tagline: Blank mask, dark high-collared tunic, an ink scroll at the hip and a tanto down the back

characters.name: Genin Scout
characters.tagline: Teal zip-up with the hood pushed back, cargo shorts, shin wraps and a fresh forehead protector

characters.name: Genin Brawler
characters.tagline: Open red vest over chain mesh, a knotted mustard sash, bandaged fists ready for taijutsu

characters.name: Genin Kunoichi
characters.tagline: Violet tunic piped in gold, mesh sleeves and leggings, a high ponytail that swings when she runs

characters.name: Genin Tracker
characters.tagline: Padded khaki zip vest up to a high collar, ribbed arm warmers, a satchel for maps and scent cloths

characters.name: Genin Scroll Bearer
characters.tagline: Blue wrap top with a red obi and a summoning scroll as long as the torso slung across the back

characters.name: Jonin Sentinel
characters.tagline: Flak vest, a cloth mask over the nose and mouth, steel-plated gloves and a tanto across the back

characters.name: Field Jonin
characters.tagline: Flak vest with sleeves rolled to the elbow, bandaged forearms and a bandana tied under the protector

characters.name: Kunoichi Jonin
characters.tagline: Flak vest over a wine shirt, a red sash and a split wrap skirt over mesh leggings

characters.name: Jonin Commander
characters.tagline: A long navy coat trimmed in red over the flak vest, the leaf crest in white across the back

clans.name: Aburame
clans.tagline: Hidden faces: round dark lenses, collars to the nose, deep hoods and the kikaichu in earthy olive, moss and dusty brown

clans.name: Akimichi
clans.tagline: Wild red-brown manes, red lacquered armor with the food kanji, white scarves and snack pouches

clans.name: Gekko
clans.tagline: A quiet family of swordsmen of the Crescent Moon: pale, tired-eyed, dressed in night indigo and moonlight silver, a blade always on the back or at the hip

clans.name: Hagane
clans.tagline: Steel-named gate guards and messengers of the Hidden Leaf: spiky dark hair, a bandage across the nose, steel-plated bracers and shin guards, a mace on the back, in gunmetal and rust-orange with off-white.

clans.name: Haruno
clans.tagline: A cheerful merchant household whose children became ninja: cherry-blossom pink and honey-blonde hair, red qipao tops with the white circle on the back, beige and rose shop wear

clans.name: Hatake
clans.tagline: Silver hair that defies gravity, cloth masks and slanted protectors, the White Fang's tanto

clans.name: Hyuga
clans.tagline: Pale Byakugan eyes, long straight dark hair and off-white wrapped robes trimmed in lavender and navy

clans.name: Inuzuka
clans.tagline: Wild-haired ninken handlers of the Hidden Leaf: fur-lined hoods, rugged tracker wear and red fang marks on both cheeks.

clans.name: Kurama
clans.tagline: A refined household of genjutsu painters: wisteria lilac, paper cream and ink, soft side-parted waves, brushes and scrolls.

clans.name: Morino
clans.tagline: Stern interrogators of the Torture and Interrogation Force: long black greatcoats, cloth protector caps, heavy boots, slate and black with oxblood, scarred faces.

clans.name: Namiashi
clans.tagline: Quiet swordsmen of the Hokage's guard, the 'wave-foot' family: deep teal-black and ink-blue cloth with pale grey wave trims, a black kokuto across the back or at the hip, and sometimes the burn scar the clan wears as a mark.

clans.name: Nara
clans.tagline: Lazy strategists of the deer forest: pineapple tails, open flak vests over mesh, olive, brown and shadow-black.

clans.name: Sarutobi
clans.tagline: The Will of Fire's own house: monkey-king armor, guardian sashes and long scarves, warm browns and greens with fire-red.

clans.name: Senju
clans.tagline: The clan of a thousand hands: long dark manes and white spikes, red and navy Warring States armor laced in green, forest haori and calm village kimono under the split-circle crest.

clans.name: Shimura
clans.tagline: Austere grey, charcoal, off-white and black with one dark-red accent: Danzo's council robes, bandages and the hidden Root

clans.name: Suzuran
clans.tagline: Lily of the valley: porcelain-white medic coats over pale jade and leaf green, white bells on green stems, vial sashes, long gloves, fume masks and a drop of toxic violet
clans.ability: Lily blood: a hereditary resistance to poisons and the art of brewing toxins and antidotes into chakra-infused medicines

clans.name: Tobari
clans.tagline: The night curtain: silent scouts, night watchmen and lantern-keepers in layered indigo drapes and hooded mantles, mufflers pulled over the mouth, soft split-toe boots and one small amber paper lantern
clans.ability: Tobari, the night curtain: a technique that smothers sound and dims chakra in a small radius, the Leaf's best scouts and night watch

clans.name: Tsuchigumo
clans.tagline: The earth-spider clan of the mountain shrine: plum, ochre and umber shrine cloth edged with web-line trims, spider crests, shimenawa ropes and thread-bound limbs
clans.ability: Tsuchigumo forbidden jutsu: a spider seal that gathers natural energy (Creation of Heaven and Earth) to release Fury, a blast able to level a village

clans.name: Uchiha
clans.tagline: Blue-black hair, high navy and black collars with the red-and-white fan on the back, and now and then the red of the Sharingan.

clans.name: Uzumaki
clans.tagline: Red hair of every shade, sealing robes, seal-tag trim and the whirlpool of Uzushiogakure

clans.name: Yamanaka
clans.tagline: Platinum ponytails, sleek purple and lavender, bandaged limbs, the flower shop and the sensor corps

clans.name: Yuhi
clans.tagline: Wild black waves and crimson eyes, rose-and-thorn bandage wraps, mist-grey haori: the genjutsu clan

collections.name: Core
collections.tagline: The first general ninja wardrobe: the Leaf's standard field kit before the collections expanded it.
